title: Lightly Salted Japanese Salmon Poke
description: A salty, springy, and refreshing Japanese dish featuring sashimi-cut salmon, paella rice, and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients, perfect for a hangover cure.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and salt.
Add the cooked paella rice to the bowl and stir until the rice is well coated with the sauce.
In a separate bowl, mix together the sashimi-grade salmon, black sesame seeds, and scallions.
Add the salmon mixture to the bowl with the rice and stir gently until combined.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, give the poke a gentle stir and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Serve the poke in small bowls or cups and garnish with additional scallions and sesame seeds if desired.
